description: PR1/core. One additive migration: blog_posts table. Columns: status (lifecycle), seed_kind+edge_ref (reserved for deferred candidate path), concept_ids[2], angle, voice (reserved), model (default deepseek), scope_mode + blocked/whitelisted arrays, priority, created_by (TEXT, no FK — synthetic tailnet operator email), title, slug UNIQUE, content, chunks_used JSONB, cost_usd, error_note, timestamps. Style: IF NOT EXISTS (re-run no-op), NO CHECK constraints (validate in app, per 012_chat_voice.sql precedent), numbered after 012 — 013 confirmed free on current main. Indexes: idx_blog_posts_status(status,created_at DESC), idx_blog_posts_published(published_at DESC) WHERE status=published. gen_random_uuid already available (migrations/002). DONE: npm run migrate clean + no-op on re-run; backslash-d blog_posts shows cols+indexes. Tests: none (schema). DEPS: none. BLOCKS: T3,T4. See IMPL T1.

resolution.note: blog_posts table created (migrations/013_blog_posts.sql); npm run migrate applies clean + no-op on re-run; \d blog_posts shows all 24 columns, both indexes (idx_blog_posts_status, idx_blog_posts_published partial), and slug unique constraint. Schema-only, no tests per spec.
